name: hdie_pc_ctrl_cfg

job.purpose: H6 after H4 GRT failure33 overflow: diagnostic full-M5 SRAM no-overflight reservation removed every capacity-zero SRAM pin-face marker (33->11 overflow). Remaining11 are positive-capacity channel overloads, mainly west x2..24/y133..134. Reserve the entire M5 macro footprint via OT_MEG_DEPTH_UM=48 using the same add/remove guard and ECO propagation; widen west logic/routing corridor34.56->56.16um by moving both SRAMs+21.6um and growing outline164.16x164.16->185.76x164.16, keeping east clearance. +3545.856um2/PC (+0.113467392mm2 for32PC), +0 cycles, same actual SRAM/logic/pin faces/layer cap/clock/signoff. Retain H4 RTL because H5 one-hot eligibility reduced gates but worsened TT placement diagnostic -29.2->-60.9ps; H4 production exact/mutants remain source-identical.

pin_regs.reason: the RTL registers its boundary itself (OREG: every PHY command output from a flop; KREG: K request in a 2-entry pin skid, k_rdy from a register; KRREG: K response from a 2-entry skid; RREG: PHY return valid+data captured at the pin; pc_id/refresh_reload straps captured in pc_id_q/refresh_reload_q). Flow pin registers would add a cycle inside the elastic K ready/valid handshake (HBM-stack boundary, owner 10-14) and overflow the skids.
